slices.focus: Amelia's homemade masala fish lunch inspires Saira to replace meal deals with packed leftovers
slices.summary: After Amelia teases Saira about her sad meal-deal sandwich while eating homemade masala fish, Saira starts intentionally packing leftovers for long dispensary days. She establishes a simple rule: dinner leftovers automatically become next day's lunch, with a freezer backup for gaps. Containers moved to eye level.
open_loops: Freezer backup supply needs to be maintained
Simple packing mental checklist (main + fresh + snack) not yet automatic
Bought lunch as exception, not default, needs to stick
decisions: Saira shifted from defaulting to supermarket meal deals on long workdays to bringing packed leftovers and simple lunches
